text:
alex: Heads up — after landing the microbatch scheduling tweak yesterday we're seeing a 10-12% 95th latency regression on PP bubble paths for 8-microbatch runs. profile dump attached below, thinking kernel selection + kvcache interactions might be the culprit.

alex: quick profiler excerpt:
```
route: pp_bubble / model-x / 1f1b
microbatch=8, seq=2048
kv_cache_hit_rate=0.62
node0 allreduce: avg=3.2ms p95=4.1ms -> now avg=8.9ms p95=11.0ms
kernel_selector: chosen=matmul_f16_opt_v2 fallback=matmul_f16_generic
dispatch_time: +9.6% on node2
```

priya: Oof. Do we have a before/after of the kernel-selector decision logs? Could be falling back to slow kernels when sequence len spikes.

jamal: Also check inter-node PCIe link utilization. Allreduce blowup usually indicates NCCL algo change or cross-host buffering. Did we roll any NCCL or cuda driver drift?

maria: Not that I know of. infra-bot rolled the runtime image 2 days ago (runtime:2024.05.09-rc3) but sys drivers stayed the same.

infra-bot: runtime-image deployed to staging at 2024-05-09T02:14Z — tag runtime:2024.05.09-rc3.

priya: Can you paste the kernel_selector trace? There's a subtlety: our heuristic_v2 picks matmul_f16_opt_v2 for typical seq<1536, but for >1536 it probes tiled kernels which regress on some SM configs.

alex: pasted. The trace shows fallbacks on rank2 for several heads.

alex: trace snippet:
```
[kernel_selector] probe sequence_length=2048 -> prefer tiled_matmul_v3
tiled_matmul_v3: mem_alloc_peak=1.2GB -> OK
tiled_matmul_v3: launch_time=4.6ms (p95 5.2ms)
fallback -> matmul_f16_generic: launch_time=10.8ms
```

jamal: So we probe tiled v3, it appears stable on node0/node1 but on node2 it hits a different path (maybe different SM arch or JIT path) and then falls back, which explains the skew and the allreduce stall while one rank lags.

priya: That also ties to KV cache hit pattern. With lower hit rate (0.62) we touch keys more, so more memory ops at higher seq lengths which stress the tiled kernel memory path.

maria: Quick experiments to run: (1) force kernel_selector=heuristic_v1 for PP bubble runs and repro, (2) lower microbatch to 4 and check 95th, (3) collect nccl topo and socket/pci util. I'll kick off 1 & 2 on staging.

alex: Commands I used to collect profiling:
```
# runtime debug flags
REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 ./run_inference --model model-x --pp 8 --microbatch 8 --seq 2048 --profile /tmp/prof.json
# collect nccl diagnostics
NCCL_DEBUG=INFO ./run_inference ...
```

jamal: I'll gather nccl-reports from the job dir and run `nvidia-smi dmon`/`nvlinkTopo` during repro. If one host has different fabric bandwidth it inflates allreduce.

priya: Another angle: batching heuristics might be packing an extra short sequence into the same kernel launch causing prologue alignment issues — try toggling `packing_threshold=0.25` -> `0.5` in `batcher.conf` to see if launch sizes change.

maria: Running the forced-selector job now (heuristic_v1). Kickoff logs: job 2456 started at 1718001402.

alex: Results so far (forced selector): microbatch=8, selector=heuristic_v1 -> 95th latency dropped to +2% (ok), kv_hit_rate unchanged. Allreduce times normalized on node2. Looks promising.

maria: Nice. Now try microbatch=8 + packing_threshold=0.5 to ensure we didn't just hide the problem.

maria: packing change run started 1718001580.

jamal: nccl-report from the first failing run attached: shows fallback to ring algorithm on the spotty host (ring -> slower for large messages) and higher retry counts.

priya: If we confirm heuristic_v2 misprobes on certain SM arch, we should update kernel_selector to include a micro-arch blacklist or add a cheap probe at startup that caches best-kernel per rank. That avoids per-request probing.

alex: Agreed. Action plan:
- jamal: collect full nccl reports and node hardware/driver diffs (due 1718002400)
- priya: prepare patch to kernel_selector to skip tiled_matmul_v3 on flagged SMs and add a one-time probe cache (PR draft)
- maria: run expanded A/B on staging with forced selector + packing threshold sweep (in progress)

maria: Also found a small KV cache race when concurrent hits/evictions occur under high microbatch concurrency — it's low probability but could exacerbate mem pressure at seq=2048. I'll instrument kv_cache stats to emit per-batch eviction counts.

alex: Thanks all. If forced selector keeps stable numbers we should revert heuristic_v2 in next canary until selector patch lands. :thumbsup:
